lines.text: Many learners say: I did a shower this morning.
Better: I took a shower this morning.
Take! I take a shower every day.

data.wrong: I did a shower this morning.
data.right: I took a shower this morning.

native.tip: 한국어 “샤워하다”는 ‘하다’를 쓰기 때문에 do로 옮기기 쉬워요. 샤워는 take a shower라고 해요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I took a shower this morning.”
native.caption: “I did a shower this morning.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “샤워하다”는 ‘하다’를 쓰기 때문에 do로 옮기기 쉬워요. 샤워는 take a shower라고 해요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I took a shower this morning.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “take”! 이 표현을 넣어 소리 내어 한 문장 말해 보세요. 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해요: {link}

en.tip: A shower goes with take. Say “I took a shower this morning.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I did a shower this morning.” A shower goes with take. Right: “I took a shower this morning.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
